reviews.text: really like this cleanser! it has a nice subtle refreshing scent which makes it more enjoyable to use for me. it’s creamy but also kind of like a gel? it foams and cleanses good without over stripping as well. I think it’s also slightly calming idk, but I really like using it. I have normal skin. it might dry out drier skin types though. will probably repurchase!
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款潔面產品！佢有一股淡淡嘅清新香味，令我用起嚟更開心。佢係奶霜質地，但又有啲似啫喱？起泡、清潔效果都好好，唔會太過奪走油分。我覺得佢都有啲舒緩作用，我都唔太肯定，但我真係好鍾意用。我皮膚係正常，對比較乾性嘅皮膚嚟講，可能會令佢哋更乾。會再買！

reviews.text: I have been using this cleanser for a long time now, and I have nothing negative to say about it. After cleansing, it leaves my face moisturized and smooth. It isn't harsh to the skin (from personal experience) and it washes the impurities away nicely. Indeed a very calming cleanser, and that's why I decided to get another one. I recommend it! ❤️
reviews.zh: 我用呢款潔面產品用咗好長時間，對佢冇任何負面嘢要講。潔完面之後，佢令面部保持滋潤、柔滑。對皮膚唔會太刺激（以我嘅個人經驗），而且可以好好地洗走污垢。確實係一款非常舒緩嘅潔面產品，所以我決定再買一支。我推薦！❤️

reviews.text: I highly recommend the ROUND LAB Mugwort Cleanser. It is a very good product if you are looking for a gentle, daily wash that respects your skin barrier. It lathers up into a soft foam and leaves the skin feeling clean, hydrated, and deeply refreshed. It has a subtle, natural herbal scent that is very relaxing. Since it keeps my skin calm and smooth, I will absolutely repurchase it!
reviews.zh: 我極力推薦 ROUND LAB 艾草潔面產品（Mugwort Cleanser）。如果你想搵一款溫和、日常用、又會尊重皮膚屏障嘅潔面產品，呢款非常好。佢打出柔軟嘅泡沫，用完之後皮膚感覺清潔、水潤，同埋深層清爽。佢有一種淡淡、天然嘅草本香味，好放鬆。因為佢令我皮膚平靜、柔滑，我一定會再買！

reviews.text: I really love ROUND LAB cleansers in general—I feel like I’ve tried almost all of them, and they’ve all been very reliable for my skin. This one, along with the ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Cleanser, is one of my favorites. It leaves my skin feeling clean but never tight or stripped, which is very important for me. It’s gentle enough that it doesn’t dehydrate my skin, but still effective enough to remove sunscreen properly. When I wear makeup, I usually combine it with an oil cleanser for a double cleanse routine, and it works really well that way.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意 ROUND LAB 嘅潔面產品，我覺得差唔多試晒佢哋所有產品，而且每一款對我嘅皮膚都好可靠。呢款，連同 ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Cleanser，係我最愛嘅其中兩款。用完之後皮膚感覺清潔，但唔會覺得緊繃或者被奪走水分，呢點對我嚟講好重要。佢夠溫和，唔會令皮膚脫水，但又有足夠效力去徹底清除防曬。我化妝嗰陣，通常會配合油類潔面產品做雙重潔面，效果一流。

reviews.text: as someone with dry, sensitive and rosacea prone skin I rly like this cleanser. It's not as stripping as the roundlab dokdo one and it foams nicer in my opinion. Also it doesn't smell as bad as the dokdo one, it kinda just smells like grass? plants? the consistency is lighter than the dokdo cleanser and it's much less stripping, but still has basically the same cleansing power. In the pics, the blob on the left is the mugwort cleanser and the blob on the right is the dokdo one
reviews.zh: 作為一個皮膚乾、敏感又易泛紅嘅人，我好鍾意呢款潔面產品。佢唔會似 roundlab dokdo 嗰款咁奪走水分，我覺得起泡效果都好啲。另外，佢冇 dokdo 嗰款咁難聞，有啲似草、植物嘅味道？質地比 dokdo 潔面產品輕，而且奪水分少好多，但清潔力基本上一樣。相片入面，左邊嗰一摊係艾草潔面產品，右邊嗰一摊係 dokdo 嗰款。

reviews.text: I have rosacea and I often get flareups which consist of itchiness and random red spots. I bought it because I love this brand and saw that this product had calming ingredients. This does wonders on my itchy face when my flareups happen, it immediately minimizes and calms the urge to scratch my skin. I absolutely recommend it for people with sensitive skin or people with rosacea. The amount of product is great as well, a little goes a long way so this will last you for a while.
reviews.zh: 我有酒糟，經常會發作，會痕同出現唔規則嘅紅點。我買呢款係因為我好鍾意呢個品牌，而且見到呢款產品有舒緩成分。當我發作嗰陣，呢款對我痕嘅皮膚效果好好，即時減少同舒緩想抓皮膚嘅衝動。我絕對推薦俾敏感皮膚或者有酒糟嘅人。呢款份量都好多，只需少少就用得好耐。

reviews.text: I’ve tried many many Korean cleansers before and this has to be the best. 11/10 fr I have sensitive acne prone skin with but of hyperpigmentation and redness and this cleanser is very soothing on my skin and it’s honestly the first time I use a product without breaking out or my skin reacting to it. it’s very foamy and cleanses really nice without stripping the oil.
reviews.zh: 我試過好多韓國潔面產品，呢款一定係最好嘅！11/10 真心。我有敏感、易長痘嘅皮膚，但有啲色素沉澱同泛紅，呢款潔面產品對我皮膚好舒緩，而且係我第一次用產品唔會爆痘或者皮膚有反應。佢起好多泡，清潔得好好，又唔會奪走油分。

reviews.text: ROUND LAB - Mugwort Calming Cleanser has become a staple in my skincare routine. This gentle cleanser effectively removes impurities without stripping my skin's natural moisture. The mugwort extract provides a soothing, calming effect, making it perfect for sensitive skin. Its subtle herbal scent is a bonus. I love how refreshed and clean my skin feels after using it. A must-try for anyone looking for a mild, effective cleanser
reviews.zh: ROUND LAB - 艾草舒緩潔面產品已經成為我護膚程序入面嘅必備產品。呢款溫和潔面產品可以有效去除污垢，又唔會奪走我皮膚嘅天然水分。艾草提取物有舒緩、鎮靜效果，令佢非常適合敏感皮膚。佢淡淡嘅草本香味係額外好處。我好鍾意用完之後皮膚感覺清新、潔淨。非常值得俾任何想要溫和、有效潔面產品嘅人試吓。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
